Sandbox_SloppyExpansion_standingOnly: No attacks from a seat or the ground
Sandbox_SloppyExpansion_standingOnly_too: An NPC will not start a melee swing or a shot while sitting, lying, in bed, prone, knocked down or getting up. It stands up first.
Sandbox_SloppyExpansion_wakeOnHit_toolti: A hit wakes a sleeping NPC at once, instead of it sleeping through the beating.
Sandbox_SloppyExpansion_tiredDamage_tool: NPC melee damage against people drops as the attacker tires, in four steps like the tiredness moodle. Fights with the dead are untouched.
Sandbox_SloppyExpansion_tiredFrom: Fatigue where blows start to weaken (0-100)
Sandbox_SloppyExpansion_tiredFrom_toolti: 60 is where the first tiredness moodle appears. Blows are untouched below this; the four steps are spread evenly from here to 100, so changing this value moves all of them.
Sandbox_SloppyExpansion_tiredDamageStart: Damage lost at the first step (0-100)
50 means the first step halves the blow, so a hit the mod would multiply to 3x lands at 1.5x.
Sandbox_SloppyExpansion_tiredDamageMost: Damage lost at the last step (0-100)
Sandbox_SloppyExpansion_tiredDamageMost_: 85 means an exhausted NPC hits for 15 percent of normal. The two steps in between are the even in-between values of these two numbers.
Sandbox_SloppyExpansion_tiredMiss_toolti: Extra miss chance against people, on top of the damage penalty. Off by default.
Sandbox_SloppyExpansion_tiredMissMost: Miss chance at the last step (0-100)
Sandbox_SloppyExpansion_tiredMissMost_to: Miss chance at the last step. The first step adds none; the steps share the same boundaries as the damage penalty.
Sandbox_SloppyExpansion_hardenBlow: Extra blow damage on the player
Sandbox_SloppyExpansion_hardenBlow_toolt: The mod's extra body-part damage after a melee blow lands on the player. Off means the shipped multiplier is disabled.
Sandbox_SloppyExpansion_hardenBlowPercen: Total multiplier on a melee blow to the player, head and neck included. 300 is the shipped value, 150 half of it. It is applied to the blow after fatigue, so a halved tired blow at 300 lands at 150 percent of normal.
Sandbox_SloppyExpansion_staggerDown: Hits can keep an NPC down
Sandbox_SloppyExpansion_staggerDown_tool: A hit on an NPC that is already on the ground can knock it down again, keeping it there for more hits.
Sandbox_SloppyExpansion_staggerDownChanc: Rolled on every hit against an NPC that is already down.
Sandbox_SloppyExpansion_forceOn: Run on an untested Last Ones Standing version
Sandbox_SloppyExpansion_forceOn_tooltip: TESTING ONLY. The patch normally turns itself off when Last Ones Standing is not the version it was written for. Turn this on to run it anyway, for example to try a new build before rebasing. It may break saves and can leave NPCs or containers in states the patch cannot repair.
